one_line: Formidable 16th‑century Tripura Maharaja who led his kingdom’s military to its zenith.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, athletic and disciplined build with the presence of a seasoned commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium‑brown complexion, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache with a short beard along the jawline; default expression is calm, assessing confidence with a hint of stern resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high topknot at the back of the crown, wrapped with a narrow red cloth band; no crown, but a simple gold forehead ornament (small central disc) at the hairline for royal dignity.
appearance.costume: Era‑accurate northeastern royal‑warrior attire: a knee‑length off‑white cotton angarkha‑style tunic with overlapping front panels tied with inner cords, worn over a deep forest‑green cotton jama/coat that has long fitted sleeves and flared skirt, the coat edged with a narrow golden‑yellow woven border; a broad maroon silk patka (sash) wraps tightly around his waist with the tied end hanging on his left side, subtly patterned with thin gold stripes; lower body in straight, slightly tapered off‑white cotton churidar‑style trousers gathered at the ankles; on his shoulders and upper chest he wears a simple, practical bronze‑toned metal breastplate (smooth, slightly curved, covering front torso over the coat) with two leather shoulder straps; feet in dark brown leather strapped sandals; arms adorned with two plain gold bangles on each wrist and a single signet ring on his right hand; small gold stud earrings complete the royal detailing.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved Talwar‑style steel sword with a dark iron hilt and disc‑shaped pommel, carried in a plain dark brown leather scabbard with a narrow brass chape, slung from his maroon waist sash to hang on his left hip.

ref_desc: Vijaya Manikya II is a medium‑brown, sharp‑eyed man in his early 30s with a black topknot, trimmed moustache and jawline beard, wearing an off‑white tunic under a forest‑green coat with golden trim, maroon waist sash, simple bronze breastplate, churidar trousers, brown sandals, gold ornaments, and carrying a curved Talwar in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip in a maroon‑green‑gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character sheet of Vijaya Manikya II, a 16th‑century Tripura Maharaja: a medium‑brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, high cheekbones, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, and a neatly trimmed moustache with a short beard along the jawline; his black hair is pulled into a high topknot at the back of the crown, wrapped with a narrow red cloth band, and he wears a small round gold forehead ornament at the hairline. Dress him in an era‑plausible northeastern royal‑warrior outfit: a knee‑length off‑white cotton angarkha‑style tunic with overlapping panels under a deep forest‑green long‑sleeved jama/coat that flares at the skirt and is edged with a narrow golden‑yellow woven border. Around his waist, wrap a broad maroon silk sash (patka) with subtle thin gold stripes, tied firmly with the end hanging on his left side. Show straight, slightly tapered off‑white churidar‑style trousers gathered at the ankles, and dark brown leather strapped sandals on his feet. Over his chest and shoulders place a simple bronze‑toned metal breastplate with a smooth, slightly curved front and two leather shoulder straps, worn over the coat, clearly functional rather than decorative. Add minimal royal jewellery: two plain gold bangles on each wrist, a single gold signet ring on his right hand, and small gold stud earrings. His signature weapon is a long, slightly curved Talwar‑style steel sword with a dark iron hilt and disc‑shaped pommel, in a plain dark brown leather scabbard with a brass tip, slung from his maroon sash to rest at his left hip. Use a restrained palette dominated by off‑white, forest green, maroon, golden yellow, and dark brown, and pose him in a neutral stance with calm, authoritative expression, showing front, side, and rear views to clarify the consistent hairstyle, costume, and weapon placement.
